title: Here's Why It's A Bad Idea To Point A Loaded Gun At An Officer
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On August 4th, 2023. An undercover cop was on patrol when a man on a bike decided to point his gun at an officer. The man seemed to be under a lot of drugs and didn’t seem to know where he went wrong in the whole situation. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
